rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when someone feels intimidated or loses courage in the face of a person, task, or situation.

example.english: Seeing such a big snake would daunt me immediately.
example.traditional: 見到咁大條蛇，我即刻嚇窒。
example.jyutping: gin3 dou2 gam3 daai6 tiu4 se4 ngo5 zik1 hak1 haak3 zat6

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on discouraging someone by undermining their confidence rather than frightening them.

example.english: Failing several interviews in a row can really daunt you.
example.traditional: 連續幾次面試失敗，真係好打擊信心。
example.jyutping: lin4 zuk6 gei2 ci3 min6 si5 sat1 baai6 zan1 hai6 hou2 daa2 gik1 seon3 sam1

rows.note: Use this when something daunts or deters A from going ahead or taking action.

example.english: Such complicated application procedures daunt many people.
example.traditional: 申請手續咁繁複，令不少人卻步。
example.jyutping: san1 cing2 sau2 zuk6 gam3 faan4 fuk1 ling6 bat1 siu2 jan4 koek3 bou6
